How to use Uplink ServiceOps Console

Service desk technicians and small IT teams who want tickets, assets, projects and network operations in one console. Private for now.

Read the bookContact

WalkthroughMotion design, real screens

It plays by itself. Tap a dot or the arrows to move, Pause to stop.

01Get started

Five steps, five minutes.

1

Sign in; a personal practice lab is created the first time.

2

Open the queue and take the first ticket.

3

Search a site, an IP address or a serial number from the global search.

4

Update the status as you work; the queue reads at a glance.

5

Switch to dark mode in the server room.

02Room by room

What is inside, and how to use it.

01Tickets

Tickets

A queue with status coded workflows and the technician's view first.

HOW TO USE IT

  1. Take a ticket
  2. Read and investigate
  3. Change the status
  4. Close with a resolution
02Assets

Assets

Devices, serial numbers, sites and owners, kept in step with reality.

HOW TO USE IT

  1. Search a serial
  2. Open the device
  3. Update the owner or the site
  4. Link it to a ticket
03Projects and network

Projects and network

Projects with tasks, and network operations with sites and addresses.

HOW TO USE IT

  1. Open a project
  2. Tick tasks
  3. Open a site
  4. Check addresses
03Tips
  • Use the global search before opening a module.
  • Practice in the lab before the first real ticket.
  • Dark theme for the server room, light for the desk.
04FAQ
Can I try it?

It is private for now. Ask for a walkthrough by email.

Is it related to Uplink?

Yes; it is the console learners will graduate into.

When does it launch?

After the academy; no date yet.
